name: OurSpace William / Jasper Profiles with Onyx
backendNote: No Apps Script/backend source is included. The frontend client and authenticated brain bridge are bundled in js/onyx/onyx-core/brain-link.js.

serviceWorker.purpose: Merge into the authoritative OurSpace service worker later.

runtimeModes.module: Onyx widget with Lightning Storm design controls, color wheel, hex inputs and shared wallet
runtimeModes.fast-game: Feed Him MEOW complete fullscreen game embedded in both profile HTML pages
runtimeModes.slow-game: Botanical Garden Virtual & Health room and pet runtime with Lightning Storm shell
runtimeModes.work: Work fullscreen workspace, Storm palette synchronization, and currency in the Projects & Catalog header

professorOnyx.module: chest-up only: caring is shown as a user begins a Health message; the module renderer remains separate.
professorOnyx.virtual: single full-body Professor contact-sheet actor in Virtual Health; chest-up widget canvas is never mounted as the room actor.
professorOnyx.transition: quadruped caring -> thoughtful quadruped Professor cue -> dedicated atlas rise -> biped walk -> turn at standard couch seat -> settle/sit -> remain seated Professor; after 10 minutes of user inactivity stand/walk away/reverse rise -> quadruped caring -> Good boy click -> purring/autonomous cat routine.
professorOnyx.quadrupedProfessor: The prelude uses Onyx’s existing full-body quadruped atlas with the thoughtful mood. Biped clothes and transition/seated poses come from the dedicated Professor contact sheet. The chest-up widget is separate.
professorOnyx.testWindow: Ten-minute timeout is measured from the last user message or Health composer/Virtual Health pointer, keyboard, or input activity. Assistant replies do not reset it. Good boy is disabled until Onyx has returned to caring.

testKeys.2: Walk to the standard couch seat edge
testKeys.X: Sit at the standard seat edge with feet aligned to the floor

professorOnyx.quadrupedCouchRest: Four named quadruped lounge, curl, and loaf spots; C cycles the spots.

avatarRendering.moduleWidget: portal-era procedural chest-up renderer for all ten canonical moods
avatarRendering.fallbackPolicy: static mood PNGs only on code-render failure
avatarRendering.gameScope: The module keeps its ten chest-up coded moods. Virtual Health uses the matching full-body atlas for each of nine quadruped moods plus the neutral base-cat atlas; Professor Onyx uses the dedicated biped contact-sheet actor. Feed Him MEOW routing remains unchanged.

gameRouting.moduleBubble: js/bubble-module + css/bubble-module; ten chest-up coded moods; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyrannosaurusdm92/LifeHelpers/main/OurSpace/assets/images/shared/legacy-static/onyx_<mood>.png are fallback-only
gameRouting.leisure: Complete Feed Him MEOW source formerly in meow.html is embedded through js/onyx/onyx-core/shared-shells.js and loads the merged leisure runtime.
gameRouting.virtual: Virtual Health loads the Botanical Garden room, free editor, priced store, spatial perception, quadruped mood atlases/SVGs, and Professor atlas/SVGs.
gameRouting.shared: js/onyx/games/shared + css/onyx/games/shared; renderer/runtime infrastructure only, not a third game

quadrupedBaseFrames.source: neutral base-cat SVG frames plus canonical mood atlases

fullscreenSync.Feed Him MEOW: The complete game uses the Feed Him MEOW name in its button and fullscreen source; the outer red X returns to the module.
fullscreenSync.Virtual Health: Virtual & Health opens the Botanical Garden fullscreen room runtime, store, and editor
fullscreenSync.Work: Work fullscreen uses Lightning Storm design sync and currency in the Projects & Catalog header left of its title
fullscreenSync.professorForwardSeat: The contact-sheet seated Professor uses the standard couch seat edge; its visible foot anchor is aligned to the couch floor line.

frameByFrameAnimation.quadruped: Nine mood atlases plus the neutral base-cat atlas preserve weighted key timing; SVG source drawings render through the second half of frame segments as in-betweens.
frameByFrameAnimation.biped: Professor atlas sequences preserve weighted key timing and use Professor SVG source drawings as in-between poses for entry, walking, sitting, and preparation.
frameByFrameAnimation.directionCoverage: Eight movement inputs map to six authored atlas facings and six directional SVG run, jump, and idle families.
frameByFrameAnimation.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion freezes quadruped atlas playback on a stable frame.

workFullscreen.entry: Work tab launcher generated by js/onyx/onyx-core/onyx-ui.js
workFullscreen.assets: css/onyx/onyx-core/work-tab.css, js/onyx/onyx-core/work-tab.js, shared currency/income scripts, root Work JSON, and GitHub-only https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyrannosaurusdm92/LifeHelpers/main/OurSpace/assets/images/shared/legacy-static*.png
workFullscreen.designSync: onyx-module-design-change palette is forwarded on Work iframe load and each palette change
workFullscreen.exit: Top-right red X returns to the Onyx module
workFullscreen.income: Meaningful Work conversations, attachments, subtabs, exports, projects, catalog actions, and settings award the shared wallet.

leisureFullscreen.name: Feed Him MEOW
leisureFullscreen.body: complete merged Feed Him MEOW game

testing.purpose: runtime code and Onyx source visuals only

assetSplit.overlay: Combine the testing and GitHub Onyx_export trees to resolve runtime asset references.

overrides: Enhanced merged fan messaging/runtime is retained over the older room-svg fan source.
Merged result manifest paths point to the consolidated static fallback location.
Texture CSS/JS and texture-manifest data are retained in the merged testing code tree.

dbtAssignments.storage: browser-local per user; conversation text not stored in assignments

portalLocation: project root (parent of assets/code); existing sign-in portal, not supplied or replaced
profileBackdrop: one blank full-viewport iframe (about:blank) per profile, under Onyx widget
